info.title: thalamus-service
info.summary: Samples each active definition on its cadence, grades every sample, answers assertions, and serves current verdicts, series and assertions over HTTP. Read-only against the systems it watches; holds no secret.
info.description:
The HTTP surface of `thalamus-service`, one of the components of `thalamus` v1.

Every path here is one semantic command, so the method is always POST and the path is the command's wire name under its domain's: a command is not a resource, and this document does not invent one. A status code is the outcome the specification declares — 202 for a branch that was taken, 422 for a refusal the input decides, 502 for a refusal decided outside the request — and the `outcome` property of every response body names the branch. Events emitted by a branch are published to consumers through the event transport, and the `published` property of every response body lists them too, in publication order. A branch that returns the command's response is carried out in the request that took it, so it is answered 200, and its body carries that response under `response`.

The specification declares who may invoke what (`x-ess-may-invoke` on each operation), so every command is sent as a declared actor. How a request proves which actor it is belongs to the realization, which authenticates it and hands the surface the caller; nothing in the request itself names one. The grant is checked before the command runs, and a request authenticated as no actor, or as one without the grant, is answered 403 with one standard refusal, the same for every command: `{"refused": "not granted", "actor": <name or null>}`. A 403 a declared branch answers carries `outcome` and the declared `error` instead, so a client tells the two apart by the members present. A command no declared actor may invoke is refused to every caller. Views are not grant-checked: a grant names commands, and any caller may read what a view publishes.

This component declares `reached_by: network`, so its callers are not deployed with it and this contract is the surface they reach it through. That declaration is also why the views its domains declare have paths here: a GET under `views` per projection, answering every row it holds. There is no page size, no cursor, no ordering and no filter parameter, because the specification states none — a view's filter is part of the projection, not of the request. A view that declares `params:` is the exception: each is a query parameter, described on its operation, and a view that declares `paging:` takes its page and size there.

tags.name: assertions
tags.description: A caller (a release, a merge request, a test run, a controller) asks whether named signals stayed within baseline over a window, and thalamus answers with a result, not a guess. Unknown is not a pass.

tags.name: definitions
tags.description: What is measured and how. One copy of every threshold lives here and nowhere else.

tags.name: dimensions
tags.description: The closed, per-instance set of dimension keys a sample may carry, and where each key's values resolve.

tags.name: evaluations
tags.description: One verdict over one sample, with the rule and the definition revision that decided it. Kept apart from the sample so a threshold change re-grades history without reading the source again.

tags.name: rollups
tags.description: One row per series per UTC day, kept after the raw samples leave retention. It is what a source that cannot be re-queried (history store) leaves behind.

tags.name: samples
tags.description: One reading of one signal for one series. Append-only; a sample has no lifecycle beyond being recorded.

tags.name: transitions
tags.description: A settled change of a series' verdict, emitted by the hysteresis once k consecutive evaluations agree. It copies what a reader needs from the evaluations that settled it, so it outlives their raw retention.

post.description: Close an open assertion with its result and the worst verdict over its window.

202.description: Outcome `answered`: the branch the specification declares for this input. Events this branch emits are published to consumers and listed under `published`.

403.description: No declared outcome: the standard refusal for an actor no grant admits: the request was authenticated as no actor, or as one `x-ess-may-invoke` does not list. It is checked before the command runs, so nothing was read, written or published, and the same request from a granted actor is decided by the command. Its body carries `refused` and `actor`, never the `outcome` and `error` a declared branch carries.

501.description: No declared outcome: the realization is unfinished. Either a port this command runs reported an unmet obligation, and nothing was written: `committed` is `false`. Or the command's effect was committed and delivering what this command published to a binding failed: `committed` is `true`, the effect and its events stand, and each binding whose delivery failed keeps its event and is attempted again on a later delivery, while no other binding receives it twice. Do not retry: after a failed delivery a retry performs the command a second time.

thalamus.definition.ConnectionId.title: ConnectionId
thalamus.definition.ConnectionId.description: A Connectors connection id. Thalamus holds no secret; the connection holds the credential. The id local is reserved for the host adapter, which reads only the machine thalamus runs on and refuses every other connection; a source of any other adapter on connection local is refused.

thalamus.definition.DenominatorSpec.title: DenominatorSpec
thalamus.definition.DenominatorSpec.description: The population a ratio or count is taken over.

min_n.description: Below this population the verdict is N/A.

since.description: The earliest moment the population could contain anything, as a reference (dimension.created, source retention start, first sample).

thalamus.definition.EvaluationSpec.title: EvaluationSpec
thalamus.definition.EvaluationSpec.description: How a sample is graded. The only copy of the signal's thresholds.

min_trend_window.description: For an instant signal, no delta and no trend below this window.

fixed.description: The number a fixed baseline is (a hard zero, or no history yet). A fixed baseline without it is unknown, never 0.

rolling_n.description: The N of a rolling_median baseline, the median of the last N samples of the series. Required when baselines name rolling_median.

mapping.description: A producer's own vocabulary mapped onto the ladder (a colour, a detector or gate exit code to OK, WARN, CRIT or UNKNOWN). Required, and not empty, when the rule is producer_mapped, and refused under any other rule; a producer value it does not list is UNKNOWN.

thalamus.definition.ExtractorId.title: ExtractorId
thalamus.definition.ExtractorId.description: A built-in extractor (sql.ratio) or a plugin id. The host adapter reads exactly five, host.cpu_busy, host.memory_used and host.disk_used (unit 1, disk per listed mount), host.disk_free (unit By, the bytes available to an unprivileged writer per listed mount) and host.cpu_temperature (unit Cel), and nothing else.

thalamus.definition.History.title: History
thalamus.definition.History.description: source means the source can be re-queried at an offset; store means only thalamus remembers the series.

thalamus.definition.Links.title: Links
thalamus.definition.Links.description: What the signal is evidence about.

thalamus.definition.Persistence.title: Persistence
thalamus.definition.Persistence.description: How many evaluations must agree before a verdict change is a transition (design § 3.2, § 11 D15). Absent on a definition, the service applies k 2, k_crit 1, m 3.

k.description: Consecutive agreeing evaluations before a change of verdict settles.

k_crit.description: Consecutive agreeing evaluations before a change to CRIT settles.

m.description: Consecutive OK evaluations before a WARN clears.

thalamus.definition.QueryText.title: QueryText
thalamus.definition.QueryText.description: Query text, stored once and hashed into every sample.

thalamus.definition.SignalDefinition.title: SignalDefinition
thalamus.definition.SignalDefinition.description: One signal; what is measured, from which source, and how a sample of it is graded.

dimensions.description: Keys from the instance's dimension registry; an empty list declares a signal with no dimensions.

query.description: Named query texts (numerator, denominator), stored once and hashed into every sample.

cadence.description: How often the service samples the signal.

persistence.description: The hysteresis of the signal's transitions; absent means the defaults k 2, k_crit 1, m 3.

rev.description: Revision counter; 1 at proposal, one more for every revision. An evaluation names the rev it was graded against.

thalamus.definition.SignalId.title: SignalId
thalamus.definition.SignalId.description: Stable signal id, spelled <family>.<layer>.<name> in lower case.

thalamus.definition.SignalKind.title: SignalKind
thalamus.definition.SignalKind.description: How a reading of the signal is formed. An instant signal gets no trend below its minimum trend window.

thalamus.definition.Source.title: Source
thalamus.definition.Source.description: Where a signal is read; a Connectors connection, never a credential.

thalamus.definition.Threshold.title: Threshold
thalamus.definition.Threshold.description: One line (WARN or CRIT) of a grading rule.

abs.description: Absolute floor the value must also reach.

min_events.description: Fewest events before the line applies.

thalamus.definition.Unit.title: Unit
thalamus.definition.Unit.description: A UCUM unit, case-sensitive form (1, s, By, {request}, {pod}). A ratio has unit 1.

thalamus.dimension.Dimension.title: Dimension
thalamus.dimension.Dimension.description: One registered dimension key, its rule and its registry kind.

parent.description: The key this one nests under (namespace under cluster).

otel_attribute.description: The OpenTelemetry resource attribute the key maps to (k8s.namespace.name, service.name).

thalamus.dimension.DimensionKey.title: DimensionKey
thalamus.dimension.DimensionKey.description: A dimension key (cluster, namespace, tenant, component, suite).

thalamus.dimension.DimensionRegistry.title: DimensionRegistry
thalamus.dimension.DimensionRegistry.description: The dimension registry of one instance. It is closed; a sample with an unregistered key is refused.

thalamus.dimension.DimensionRule.title: DimensionRule
thalamus.dimension.DimensionRule.description: source_only means the key is set only when the source row carries it, never derived from a parent.

thalamus.dimension.DimensionValue.title: DimensionValue
thalamus.dimension.DimensionValue.description: A value of one dimension key in one series.

thalamus.dimension.Locator.title: Locator
thalamus.dimension.Locator.description: The inventory or registry file a key's values are listed in (inventory/clusters, registries/components.json).

thalamus.dimension.RegistryId.title: RegistryId
thalamus.dimension.RegistryId.description: The instance whose dimension registry this is.

thalamus.dimension.ValueSource.title: ValueSource
thalamus.dimension.ValueSource.description: The registry kind of a key. connectors is a Connectors inventory, file a registry file in the instance, open admits any value (test-run dimensions) and carries no locator.

thalamus.evaluation.Baseline.title: Baseline
thalamus.evaluation.Baseline.description: The baseline a sample was graded against.

offsets.description: The offsets pooled (1d, 7d); empty when none.

reading.description: The baseline's own value and quality. A baseline that could not be read, or predates its series, is unknown, never 0.

thalamus.evaluation.BaselineLabel.title: BaselineLabel
thalamus.evaluation.BaselineLabel.description: Which baseline the sample was graded against (offset_pooled, fixed, rolling_median).

thalamus.evaluation.EvaluationId.title: EvaluationId
thalamus.evaluation.EvaluationId.description: An evaluation id, minted by the grader.

thalamus.evaluation.SignalEvaluation.title: SignalEvaluation
thalamus.evaluation.SignalEvaluation.description: One verdict over one sample, graded against one definition revision.

definition_rev.description: The definition revision whose rule decided the verdict.

prev.description: The series' previous verdict, so a change is visible without a second read; absent on a series' first evaluation.

score.description: 0 at the baseline, 1 at the WARN line, 2 at the CRIT line, negative when better than the baseline. Absent for UNKNOWN and N/A, never 0.

reason.description: Why the rule decided this verdict. Required on every verdict other than OK.

thalamus.evaluation.Verdict.title: Verdict
thalamus.evaluation.Verdict.description: The one verdict ladder. exit is the process exit code; rank orders an aggregate worst-first (CRIT > WARN > UNKNOWN > OK = N/A); scored says whether the verdict carries a score.

thalamus.observation.Bound.title: Bound
thalamus.observation.Bound.description: Which side a partial reading's value bounds.

thalamus.observation.Denominator.title: Denominator
thalamus.observation.Denominator.description: The population behind a ratio or count.

n.description: The population the reading was taken over.

since.description: The earliest moment the population could contain anything.

age_s.description: Seconds from since to the sample. A baseline whose offset exceeds it is UNKNOWN.

thalamus.observation.PartialReading.title: PartialReading
thalamus.observation.PartialReading.description: Read but cut (a full page, a paged read that could not finish).

value.description: A bound on the true value, never the value itself.

thalamus.observation.Provenance.title: Provenance
thalamus.observation.Provenance.description: Enough to re-run the read. Names a connection, never a credential.

thalamus.observation.QueryDigest.title: QueryDigest
thalamus.observation.QueryDigest.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the definition's query map (keys sorted, no whitespace), lower-case hex.

thalamus.observation.Reading.title: Reading
thalamus.observation.Reading.description: The value and its quality as one type. quality unknown has no value and a reason; partial has a value and its bound; ok has a value. The illegal pairs cannot be built.

thalamus.observation.RunId.title: RunId
thalamus.observation.RunId.description: Groups the samples of one sampling pass.

thalamus.observation.SampleId.title: SampleId
thalamus.observation.SampleId.description: A sample id, minted by the producer.

thalamus.observation.SeriesKey.title: SeriesKey
thalamus.observation.SeriesKey.description: One series, a signal id together with its dims values.

thalamus.observation.SignalSample.title: SignalSample
thalamus.observation.SignalSample.description: One reading of one signal for one series at one instant.

text.description: The producer's value exactly as the source printed it (a text cell, an exit code, an HTTP status), recorded only under a producer_mapped definition and only when the adapter read the value. Grading maps it through the definition's evaluation.mapping at the revision being graded, so a mapping revision re-grades history.

thalamus.observation.UnreadReading.title: UnreadReading
thalamus.observation.UnreadReading.description: Not read. Carries no value at all, so unknown can never become 0.

thalamus.rollup.DailyRollup.title: DailyRollup
thalamus.rollup.DailyRollup.description: One series over one UTC day; what remains once its samples leave raw retention (design § 4).

day.description: The UTC midnight the day starts at.

min.description: Over the day's ok readings; absent when the day has none, never 0.

p50.description: Over the day's ok readings; absent when the day has none, never 0.

max.description: Over the day's ok readings; absent when the day has none, never 0.

last.description: The last ok reading of the day; absent when the day has none, never 0.

worst_verdict.description: The worst verdict of the day by the ladder's rank; absent when the day has no evaluation.

min_score.description: Over the day's scored evaluations; absent when none carries a score, never 0.

max_score.description: Over the day's scored evaluations; absent when none carries a score, never 0.

thalamus.rollup.RollupId.title: RollupId
thalamus.rollup.RollupId.description: A rollup id, spelled from the series key and the UTC day.

thalamus.rollup.VerdictCounts.title: VerdictCounts
thalamus.rollup.VerdictCounts.description: One count per verdict of the ladder, over the day's evaluations.

thalamus.transition.Transition.title: Transition
thalamus.transition.Transition.description: One settled verdict change of one series, with the evaluations that settled it (design § 11 D13).

definition_rev.description: The definition revision of the settling evaluation.

from_verdict.description: The series' previous settled verdict; absent on its first settled verdict.

first_ts.description: The ts of the first of the agreeing evaluations.

settled_ts.description: The ts of the settling evaluation.

settling_score.description: The settling evaluation's score; absent when its verdict carries none, never 0.

evaluations.description: The k evaluations that settled the transition. One that has left raw retention reads as expired.

thalamus.transition.TransitionId.title: TransitionId
thalamus.transition.TransitionId.description: A transition id, minted by the service.
